messages:
anya: console: p95 reported > p99 for /v1/streaming in us-east for ~8m. p50 looks normal. anyone else?

ingest-bot: Alert: non-monotonic quantiles detected for route=/v1/streaming region=us-east at 2026-03-20T14:02Z.

rolf: that usually means we're merging tdigest sketches with different compression params. naive merge can produce non-monotonic results.

dena: running quick sample check: ```sql
SELECT sample_origin, tdigest_c, percentile(latency_ms,95) AS p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) AS p99, count(*)
FROM telemetry_latency
WHERE route='/v1/streaming' AND region='us-east' AND time>now()-interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY sample_origin, tdigest_c;
```

jake: results?

dena: output: frontend-proxy tdigest_c=200 p95=850 p99=820 count=9; backend tdigest_c=50 p95=120 p99=140 count=620. merged rollup shows p95=480 p99=430.

rolf: yep. small-count high-tail slice + incompatible compression -> bad merge. two quick mitigations: (1) guard merges when compression differs and keep separate rollups, (2) for small contributing counts, recompute exact quantiles from raw samples.

anya: prefer (1) short-term (avoid confusing dashboards) and queue (2) as a background job. also add a console badge "mixed-quantile-sources" when this happens.

jake: I'll open a patch: rollup-merge-guard that flags incompatible tdigest params and prevents merge. will enable in canary and add telemetry counter.

ingest-bot: Canary deploy requested: rollup-merge-guard -> 10% traffic.

dena: filed RT-5012 to track guard + exact-recompute job + UI badge + runbook note. will backfill the affected 3h window for this route after guard lands.

anya: thanks. once guard is in canary we'll annotate the dashboard and monitor for regressions. :thumbsup:
